text:
mia: FYI partner CloudForge submitted a late usage file for March after the bill run. Looks like ~$18.2k unbilled (mostly embeddings). We close EOD PDT Mar 31. Can we accrue or move to unbilled AR?

jon: Can you drop the CSV and the PO? Need to confirm which rate applies (marketplace vs direct).

mia: Pasted: PO=12345-CF. Partner billed marketplace rates internally but contract shows direct. CSV: 
```
date,resource,units,unit_rate,ext_amount
2026-03-15,embeddings,91000,0.20,18200.00
```

ravi: Given the SOW shows direct pricing, revenue has been earned. Recommend accrual to Unbilled AR and recognize revenue. Proposed JE:
```
DR 1310 Unbilled Receivable 18,200.00
CR 4000 Hosting/Inference Revenue 18,200.00
Memo: Accrual for CloudForge Mar usage (PO 12345-CF) pending invoice.
```
We'll schedule a reversing JE if invoice doesn't post by reversal window.

pam: Two approvals before posting: (1) Partner acknowledgement or PO in accounting inbox, (2) Controller approval for > $10k. Jon, can you sign off?

jon: I need the PO + partner confirmation and a quick recon vs contract rates. Also a snippet of the SOW showing direct rates.

mia: SOW excerpt: "CloudForge SOW v2 - Embeddings unit price = $0.20 per 1k tokens (direct rate). Marketplace fee not applicable."

accounting-bot: Auto-recon completed. suggested_total=18200.00; tax=0.00; je_suggested=ACCR-276945; attachments=[cloudforge_mar_usage.csv, cf_sow_v2.pdf].

ravi: Good. Mia, please email accounting@redwood.com with PO, partner email confirmation, and SOW excerpt. We'll post JE to GL 1310/4000 and set reversal for 2026-04-15 if no invoice.

pam: I'll draft the JE and leave it pending controller approval. Reversal template: DR 4000 / CR 1310.

jon: Approve to post pre-close contingent on accounting receiving the PO/email before EOD. :thumbsup:

mia: Partner emailed confirmation and ETA invoice 2026-04-05. CC'd accounting@redwood.com with PO and docs.

pam: JE posted: JE-276945-03 (status: posted after controller approval). Memo: "Accrual for late partner usage - CloudForge Mar (PO 12345-CF)". Reversal scheduled 2026-04-15 if no invoice.

jon: If partner invoices at marketplace rate instead of direct, code adjustment to product revenue bucket and reverse the overaccrual.

mia: Will monitor and update thread if invoice arrives early. :pray:

pam: Closing note - backups filed in month close binder under partners/unbilled/CloudForge/Mar-2026. Reach out if you need copies.
